metadata.name: flacon
metadata.description: FlaconVault — passport, seal and scan-proof program (briefing §6)

instructions.name: add_partner
docs: Authority only.

instructions.name: add_server_key
docs: Authority only. `valid_to == 0` = open-ended.

instructions.name: add_site
docs: Authority only. `label` is UTF-8, zero padded to 32 bytes.

instructions.name: attach_seal
docs: The passport's issuer (while a partner) or the authority. `kind` ∈ {BOX, NECK}; at most
`MAX_SEALS_PER_PASSPORT` seals; not on a void passport.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The passport's issuer while it is a partner, or the registry authority.

instructions.name: attach_seal_v2
docs: `attach_seal` with a separate payer.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The passport's issuer while it is a partner, or the registry authority.

instructions.name: init_holder_config
docs: Registry authority only, once. `cluster_tag` ∈ {1 MAINNET, 2 DEVNET, 3 LOCALNET} is immutable; every
FVSCAN2 must carry it.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be the registry authority; becomes `holder_config.authority`.

instructions.name: init_holding_v1
docs: Registry authority only, separate payer. The Holding (state WALLET) of a passport minted with v1
`mint_passport`, so it can take `record_scan_v2` scans.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be the registry authority.

instructions.name: init_registry
docs: Creates the singleton registry; the payer becomes `authority`. Only the program's upgrade
authority (checked through the ProgramData account) may call it.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Payer becomes the registry authority; must be the program's upgrade authority.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program (its ProgramData address is checked below).

instructions.name: mark_seal_dead
docs: The passport's issuer (while a partner) or the authority. Seal no longer answers → seal dead,
passport void, grade VOID.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The passport's issuer while it is a partner, or the registry authority — after a
confirmed no-response (escrow dispute or certification).

instructions.name: mint_passport
docs: Partner (or authority) only. Birth certificate of a bottle. `asset` must be a Metaplex Core
asset owned by the issuer, passed again as the `core_asset` account.

accounts.name: issuer
docs: Must be a registered partner (or the registry authority).

accounts.name: core_asset
docs: that Metaplex Core owns the account, that it is an `AssetV1` and that the issuer owns it.
Appended last so the indices of the accounts above stay unchanged.

instructions.name: mint_passport_v2
docs: Partner (or authority) signs, separate payer. A pass held in a FlaconVault account: no Core asset,
`passport.asset` = the new Holding PDA (state ACCOUNT, epoch 0, `commitment` ≠ 0).

accounts.name: issuer
docs: Must be a registered partner (or the registry authority); becomes `passport.issuer`.

instructions.name: record_scan
docs: The core: anchors one server-signed scan. Must be preceded in the same
transaction by an `Ed25519Program` instruction over the §4.3 message.

accounts.name: scan_proof
docs: One PDA per accepted scan: `["scan", seal, counter LE]` (see module docs for `init_if_needed`).

accounts.name: attester
docs: The wallet that attests the scan; pays for the ScanProof.

instructions.name: record_scan_v2
docs: Records one server-signed FVSCAN2 scan; must be a top-level instruction right after an `Ed25519Program`
instruction over the 256-byte message. Creates nothing; any fee payer. Only HOLDER, WALLET and PARTNER
scans change grade and void.

accounts.name: actor_signer
docs: WALLET and PARTNER scans only: the actor co-signs. Otherwise the program id (Anchor's "none").

accounts.name: asset
docs: WALLET scans only: the account at `passport.asset`, a Metaplex Core asset owned by the actor. Otherwise the
program id.

instructions.name: remove_partner
docs: Authority only. The removed wallet also loses `attach_seal` / `mark_seal_dead` on its passports.

instructions.name: revoke_server_key
docs: Authority only. Ends the key's validity now (`valid_to = clock − 1`); the entry is kept.

instructions.name: set_holder_config
docs: Registry authority only (the current one; `holder_config.authority` is re-synced to it). Delays within
`MIN_HOLD_DELAY_S..=MAX_HOLD_DELAY_S`.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be the registry authority (not the copy in `holder_config.authority`).

accounts.name: registry
docs: Appended after `authority`, so the IDL positions 0 and 1 stay as they were.

instructions.name: transfer_authority
docs: Current and new authority both sign.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not the registry authority

errors.name: NotPartner
errors.msg: Signer is not a registered partner

errors.name: DuplicateServerKey
errors.msg: A server key with this key_id already exists

errors.name: ServerKeysFull
errors.msg: Registry holds the maximum number of server keys

errors.name: InvalidKeyValidity
errors.msg: valid_to must be 0 (open-ended) or >= valid_from

errors.name: DuplicatePartner
errors.msg: Partner already registered

errors.name: PartnersFull
errors.msg: Registry holds the maximum number of partners

errors.name: InvalidSiteId
errors.msg: site_id 0 is reserved for 'no site'

errors.name: DuplicateSite
errors.msg: A site with this site_id already exists

errors.name: SitesFull
errors.msg: Registry holds the maximum number of sites

errors.name: InvalidSealKind
errors.msg: Seal kind must be 0 (BOX) or 1 (NECK); 2 (LOOP) is reserved

errors.name: SealCountOverflow
errors.msg: Passport seal_count overflow

errors.name: SealPassportMismatch
errors.msg: Seal does not belong to this passport

errors.name: SealDead
errors.msg: Seal is dead (no longer answers) — no further scans

errors.name: PassportVoid
errors.msg: Passport is void

errors.name: CounterNotIncreasing
errors.msg: Counter must be greater than the seal's last counter

errors.name: InvalidInstructionsSysvar
errors.msg: Instructions sysvar account mismatch

errors.name: MissingEd25519Instruction
errors.msg: The instruction before record_scan must be an Ed25519Program instruction

errors.name: MalformedEd25519Instruction
errors.msg: Ed25519 instruction data is malformed (expects exactly one signature over a 152-byte FVSCAN1 or, for record_scan_v2, a 256-byte FVSCAN2 message)

errors.name: UnknownServerKey
errors.msg: No server key with this key_id in the registry

errors.name: ServerKeyMismatch
errors.msg: Ed25519 public key does not match the registry server key

errors.name: ServerKeyNotValidAtTs
errors.msg: Server key is not valid at the given ts

errors.name: MessageMismatch
errors.msg: Signed message does not match the reconstruction from the arguments

errors.name: InvalidRole
errors.msg: role must be 0..=4

errors.name: InvalidTier
errors.msg: tier must be 0..=4

errors.name: TierNotAllowedForRole
errors.msg: OWNER/SELLER/BUYER may attest at most tier 2 (SELF_MEDIA)

errors.name: SiteIdNotAllowed
errors.msg: site_id may only be set for role VAULT or PARTNER

errors.name: UnknownSite
errors.msg: site_id is not registered

errors.name: InvalidIndicator
errors.msg: tamper/uv/hum/heat codes must be 0..=3

errors.name: InvalidFill
errors.msg: fill must be 0..=100

errors.name: InvalidHeatLevels
errors.msg: heat_levels must be a 6-bit mask (< 64)

errors.name: HeatInconsistent
errors.msg: heat must equal bit 4 of heat_levels when heat is INTACT or TRIGGERED

errors.name: ScanCountOverflow
errors.msg: Passport scan_count overflow

errors.name: NotIssuerOrAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is neither the passport issuer (a current partner) nor the registry authority

errors.name: TooManySeals
errors.msg: Passport already holds the maximum number of seals

errors.name: ServerKeyNotValidNow
errors.msg: Server key is not valid at the current cluster time (expired or revoked)

errors.name: StaleScanTimestamp
errors.msg: Signed ts is more than MAX_SCAN_TS_SKEW_S away from the cluster clock

errors.name: CounterOutOfRange
errors.msg: counter is above the 24-bit NTAG counter range

errors.name: PartnerNotFound
errors.msg: Partner is not registered

errors.name: ServerKeyAlreadyRevoked
errors.msg: Server key is already expired or revoked

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the program's upgrade authority

errors.name: AssetMismatch
errors.msg: Asset account does not match the asset argument

errors.name: InvalidAsset
errors.msg: Asset account is not a Metaplex Core asset

errors.name: AssetNotOwnedByIssuer
errors.msg: The Core asset must be owned by the issuer when the passport is minted

errors.name: InvalidClusterTag
errors.msg: cluster_tag must be 1 (MAINNET), 2 (DEVNET) or 3 (LOCALNET)

errors.name: InvalidDelay
errors.msg: Delay must be within MIN_HOLD_DELAY_S..=MAX_HOLD_DELAY_S

errors.name: InvalidCommitment
errors.msg: Commitment must not be all zeros

errors.name: CpiNotAllowed
errors.msg: record_scan_v2 must be a top-level instruction

errors.name: InvalidMessagePrefix
errors.msg: Signed message is not an FVSCAN2 message

errors.name: WrongProgramId
errors.msg: FVSCAN2 message is bound to another program id

errors.name: WrongCluster
errors.msg: FVSCAN2 message is bound to another cluster

errors.name: InvalidPurpose
errors.msg: purpose must be 0..=6

errors.name: InvalidActorKind
errors.msg: actor_kind must be 0..=4

errors.name: InvalidSighting
errors.msg: A sighting (tier 0) has fill FILL_NONE, uv/hum/heat MISSING, heat_levels 0 and no media; FILL_NONE only with tier 0

errors.name: PurposeNotAllowed
errors.msg: purpose is not allowed for this actor kind or tier

errors.name: ActorMismatch
errors.msg: actor does not match its kind (zero for NONE, Holding.commitment for HOLDER, the signer for WALLET/PARTNER)

errors.name: MissingActorSigner
errors.msg: WALLET and PARTNER scans need the actor as signer

errors.name: NotAssetOwner
errors.msg: The WALLET actor does not own the passport's Core asset

errors.name: HoldingNotInAccount
errors.msg: HOLDER and RECIPIENT scans need a pass held in an account (Passport.asset == Holding)

errors.name: HeadCountOverflow
errors.msg: Holding head_count overflow

types.name: HolderConfig
docs: Seeds: `["holder_config"]` — the singleton settings of passes held in FlaconVault accounts
(docs/public-record.md §6.1). P1 uses `cluster_tag` (checked by `record_scan_v2`); the keys, delays,
`paused` and `last_heartbeat` are for the later phases (moves, claims, pause), which only add instructions.

fields.name: authority
docs: The registry authority at `init_holder_config` (immutable in P1).

fields.name: cluster_tag
docs: cluster enum (constants::CLUSTER_*), set once; every FVSCAN2 must carry it.

fields.name: paused
docs: Guards moves (P5); scans are evidence and ignore it.

types.name: Holding
docs: Seeds: `["holding", passport]` — the register entry of a passport (docs/public-record.md §6.2; the layout is
final from P1). `Passport.asset == this PDA` ⇒ the pass is held in a FlaconVault account under `commitment`;
otherwise the owner of the Core asset at `Passport.asset` holds it. Every `record_scan_v2` folds its message into
`scan_head`, so anyone can check that a list of v2 scans is complete and in order.

fields.name: state
docs: holding_state enum (constants::HOLDING_STATE_*)

fields.name: commitment
docs: sha256("FVHOLD1" ‖ passport ‖ epoch ‖ secret32); zero for a legacy (WALLET) holding.

fields.name: last_scan_ts
docs: Signed `ts` of the last `record_scan_v2`.

fields.name: pending_kind
docs: P3/P4: NONE 0, NOTAP 1, CLAIM 2.

fields.name: pending_target
docs: P3: the new commitment of a NOTAP move; P4: the wallet of a claim.

types.name: Passport
docs: Seeds: `["passport", serial_hash]` — the bottle's birth certificate.

fields.name: serial_hash
docs: sha256(serial, UTF-8)

fields.name: binding_hash
docs: sha256(serial ‖ batch_code ‖ uid_hash_first_seal)

fields.name: asset
docs: Metaplex Core asset (stored only, no CPI in this program).

fields.name: grade
docs: grade enum (constants::GRADE_*)

fields.name: heat_levels
docs: 6-bit mask, bit i = Thermax field i; bit 4 (40 °C) is the decisive one.

fields.name: site_id
docs: 0 = none; otherwise a registered site (only with role VAULT/PARTNER).

types.name: Registry
docs: Seeds: `["registry"]`

types.name: ScanProof
docs: Seeds: `["scan", seal, counter u32 LE]` — one PDA per accepted scan.

fields.name: heat_levels
docs: 6-bit mask, bit i = Thermax field i (29/33/34/37/40/42 °C); bit 4 is decisive.

fields.name: site_id
docs: 0 = none; otherwise a registry site (only for role VAULT/PARTNER).

types.name: ScanRecordedV2
docs: Emitted by `record_scan_v2` through `emit_cpi!` (an inner instruction, not a log line), with the full signed
message, so an indexer can re-check the signature and re-fold `scan_head`. Values after the scan.

types.name: Seal
docs: Seeds: `["seal", uid_hash]` — one NFC seal (box or neck) pointing at a passport.

fields.name: kind
docs: seal_kind enum (constants::SEAL_KIND_*)

fields.name: uid_hash
docs: sha256(uid bytes, 7)

types.name: ServerKey
docs: One accepted server signing key. `valid_to == 0` means open-ended.

fields.name: valid_to
docs: New `valid_to` (one second before the revocation's cluster time).

types.name: Site
docs: A physical location (vault, partner shop). `label` is UTF-8, zero padded.

constants.name: COMMITMENT_PREFIX
docs: `commitment = sha256("FVHOLD1" ‖ passport ‖ epoch u32 LE ‖ secret32)`

constants.name: DEFAULT_CLAIM_DELAY_S
docs: Public delay of a move to a wallet (72 h).

constants.name: DEFAULT_NOTAP_DELAY_S
docs: Public delay of a move without a tap (7 days).

constants.name: FILL_NONE
docs: `fill` value of a scan without a fill reading (every tier-0 sighting, and only those).

constants.name: GRADE_FILL_A_MIN
docs: `fill >= GRADE_FILL_A_MIN` → A

constants.name: GRADE_FILL_B_MIN
docs: `fill >= GRADE_FILL_B_MIN` → B

constants.name: HEAT_DECISIVE_INDEX
docs: Index of the decisive heat field (vectors.constants.HEAT_DECISIVE_INDEX).

constants.name: HOLDER_CONFIG_SEED
docs: `["holder_config"]`: the singleton HolderConfig (docs/public-record.md §6.1).

constants.name: HOLDING_SEED
docs: `["holding", passport]`: one Holding per passport (docs/public-record.md §6.2).

constants.name: MAX_COUNTER
docs: NTAG 424 DNA SUN counters are 24 bit; anything above cannot come from a real tap.

constants.name: MAX_SCAN_TS_SKEW_S
docs: `record_scan` accepts a signed message only while |msg.ts − cluster clock| ≤ this (seconds).

constants.name: MAX_SEALS_PER_PASSPORT
docs: A passport carries at most one BOX and one NECK seal.

constants.name: MIN_HOLD_DELAY_S
docs: `set_holder_config` accepts delays only within 1 day ..= 30 days.

constants.name: MPL_CORE_PROGRAM_ID
docs: Metaplex Core: `mint_passport` only accepts an asset account owned by this program.

constants.name: MSG2_PREFIX
docs: Prefix of the 256-byte FVSCAN2 message that `record_scan_v2` parses out of the Ed25519 instruction.

constants.name: MSG_LEN
docs: Total length of the server-signed message in bytes.

constants.name: ORIGIN_SEED
docs: Reserved for the `Origin` account (`["origin", passport]`, briefing §6).
Deliberately not implemented in the hackathon build.

constants.name: SCAN_HEAD_PREFIX
docs: `scan_head_n = sha256("FVHEAD1" ‖ scan_head_(n−1) ‖ sha256(msg_n))`
